description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Flags MUST-SUCCEED settlement/cleanup flows (stop/reclaim/close/settle/liquidate/withdraw/refund/return/claim/finalize/resolve) that push an attacker- or user-SELECTED token whose revert/blacklist/false-return/reentrancy can BLOCK the cleanup -> permanent lock or DoS of another user, with NO containment (try/catch, pull-payment, allowlist, escrow fallback). Multi-signal gate: S1 cleanup-verb fn + S2 must-succeed token push (no try/catch) + S3 order/array-sourced token + S4 missing containment + S5 counterparty recipient. Mechanism-based, NOT answer-key matching. Anchor: reNFT 2024-01 H-01 (Stop.stopRent -> PaymentEscrow._settlePayment _safeTransfer of attacker-tipped consideration token, no try/catch -> reverting token locks the rental), #64/#605 (blacklisting payment ERC20 / blacklisted lender freeze). Scope: settlement-path hostile-token DoS ONLY; NOT a generic token audit.

fp_controls.five_signal_required: S1 cleanup-verb fn AND S2 must-succeed token push (not in try/catch) AND S4 missing containment AND S5 counterparty recipient; S3 (order/array-sourced token) -> high, a bare attacker-supplied token param -> medium. A plain deposit/swap/mint that transfers tokens is not a cleanup flow -> suppressed.
fp_controls.caller_own_only_suppression: if the only transfer recipient is msg.sender (caller withdraws their OWN asset), a transfer failure harms only the caller -> suppressed (spec reject).
fp_controls.containment_suppression: try/catch isolation, a pull-payment/record-debt path, or a token allowlist/registry check -> the hostile token cannot block cleanup -> suppressed.
fp_controls.trusted_asset_suppression: token bound to an immutable/allowlisted protocol asset (not order/array-selected) -> not attacker-selected -> suppressed.
fp_controls.admin_downgrade: admin/owner-gated settlement path -> downgraded to low.
fp_controls.accounting_not_pull_payment: a plain balance ledger (balanceOf[token] -= amount) is accounting, NOT a pull-payment fallback, and does NOT suppress (the push still reverts the flow).
